item.title: Lossiemouth wins feature at Leopardstown
item.description: Lossiemouth has won today's feature race at Leopardstown - the December Hurdle. Under the ride of Paul Townend, she overcame Brighterdaysahead in a battle of the mares, to register her ninth Grade One success for trainer Willie Mullins. Gordon Elliott and Jack Kennedy continued their red-hot festive form with Wodhooh claiming the Grade Three Kerrymount Mares Hurdle. item.title: Hood's dream debut run at World Championship continues
item.description: Justin Hood's dream debut run at the PDC World Darts Championship has continued. He's through to round four after a 4-1 win against Ryan Meikle. Hood now awaits the winner of the match between Callan Rydz and Antrim's Josh Rock. Advertisement Charlie Manby booked a spot in the last-16 by beating Ricky Evans by four sets to two. Kevin Doets will face Luke Humphreys after a 4-3 win over Nathan Aspinall.

item.title: Emergency response service charity tasked to Kerry almost 100 times this year
item.description: A charity which provides an emergency response service was tasked to Kerry 95 times this year. CRITICAL was first established in 2009 as Irish Community Rapid Response and in 2019 it launched Ireland’s first and only charity air ambulance. The air ambulance is now funded by the State, and CRITICAL consists of a network of volunteers that respond alongside the National Ambulance Service when 999 or 112 is called. item.title: Demand for Adapt Women's refuge increases in 2025
item.description: The number of women seeking help due to domestic violence and coercive control continued to increase this year. Adapt Kerry women’s refuge has helped over 510 women this year seeking support. This is up from over 480 last year and 300 in 2023. Adapt Kerry had 51 admissions this year with 69 children also accommodated at its refuge in Tralee. item.title: Anthony Joshua injured in car crash
item.description: Anthony Joshua has been injured in a car crash in Nigeria, which has killed two people. Police say the from world heavyweight boxing champion has been taken to hospital. Unverified footage on social media shows Joshua being helped out of a vehicle. Advertisement

item.title: Henshaw a doubt for Leinster's URC inter-pro derby against Connacht
item.description: Robbie Henshaw is a doubt for Leinster's URC inter-pro derby against Connacht this weekend. The Ireland centre picked up a finger injury in the reining champions victory at Munster on Saturday night, and he'll be assessed again later in the week. James Culhane has resumed training with Leinster but Hugo Keenan and Garry Ringrose are among the players still out for this Saturday's game at the Aviva. item.title: South Africa through to knock-out stages of Africa Cup of Nations
item.description: South Africa are through to the knock-out stages of the Africa Cup of Nations after a 3-2 win against Zimbabwe. Already qualified Egypt drew nil-nil with Angola in their final group game. Advertisement
